visibleBehaviorFixtures.rationale: Ordinary text input must preserve surrounding text and canonical serialization.
Repeated visible text must use the requested range, not a text search result.
The browser and canonical text APIs use UTF-16 offsets; edits after a surrogate pair must preserve the pair.
Editing a child paragraph must retain its containing section and heading marker.
Editing list-item content must retain list order and markers.

intentionalDifferences.legacyBehavior: The legacy MarkdownTree has transient view-model identity and reparses source into a new tree; it has no durable node or native text identity to compare.
intentionalDifferences.canonicalBehavior: Checkpoint reconstruction preserves canonical node IDs, tape IDs, boundary IDs, and native retained text item signatures.
intentionalDifferences.rationale: Collaboration, guarded history, and selection anchors depend on canonical identity. These internal IDs are outside visible Markdown parity; visible content and structure remain equal after reconstruction.
